name: photocraft
description: Layers, masks, cutouts, retouching and filters with text and resize variants. Projects stay editable and export to PSD, PNG and other formats.

interface.shortDescription: 图层、蒙版、抠图、修复与滤镜，支持文字和尺寸适配，工程可继续编辑并导出 PSD/PNG。
interface.longDescription: Use independently maintained, checksummed skills to install pinned maintained CLIs and create editable native projects. Development release; complete capability and host acceptance remain in progress.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable PhotoCraft project from my assets
